sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 2436.1 ± 318 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by flow cytometry (anti-OX56 staining) in P2RY8-KO Ly8 cells; receptor function assessed in parallel migration assay with chemoattractant CXCL12 and P2RY8 ligand GGG, and proliferation screen — tagged receptor used as the functional reference construct throughout the DMS.
sites.rationale: The construct encodes P2RY8 aa 2–358 with an exogenous preprolactin signal peptide and OX56 tag placed immediately N-terminal to Q2; the native M1 start codon is absent, so in canonical UniProt numbering the tag is a prepend (insert_after_residue=0, residue_after=M). The extracellular N-terminus spans residues 1–23 (23 aa before TM1 at residue 24), placing the tag well beyond the ≥3-residue TM-boundary requirement. Surface display was directly confirmed by FACS and the receptor drove measurable migration and proliferation responses, establishing surface_and_function validation. Full-length P2RY8 (aa 2–358) expressed with an exogenous preprolactin signal peptide followed by an OX56 epitope tag at the N-terminus in a lentiviral construct (PRL-OX56-P2RY8-P2A-GFP); transduced into P2RY8-KO OCI-Ly8 (DLBCL) cells for deep mutational scanning.

sources.claim: The synthesized DNA consisted of the coding sequence for P2RY8 amino acids 2–358 (all codons excepting start and stop codons) along with preceding 35 bp (corresponding to OX56 tag and 5 nucleotides in preceding linker) and succeeding 35 bp (corresponding to a portion of P2A sequence).
S1PR2, P2RY8 and Tbxa2r were inserted in frame with a preprolactin leader and FLAG-epitope encoding sequence.

literature_notes: All six ledger lines describe N-terminal extracellular tags on full-length, membrane-anchored P2RY8; no ledger line supports an internal loop insertion or a C-terminal tag. L2, L3, L4, L5, and L6 all describe the same OX56 N-terminal construct (PRL-OX56-P2RY8); L2 is used as the primary supporting clip for Site 1 because it most precisely describes the construct architecture, with L4/L5/L6 providing corroborating surface and functional evidence. L1 describes a distinct FLAG-tagged full-length construct from a different study and is reported as a separate site at the same junction with lower validation. The preprolactin signal peptide is an exogenous trafficking signal that is cleaved post-translationally, leaving the epitope tag at the extracellular N-terminus; P2RY8 itself has no signal peptide (residue 1, M, is extracellular per topology landmarks). No ledger lines describe intracellular insertions or function-abrogating positions for P2RY8.
